title: Plan-Review-Execute with Claude Code
problem: Individual delivery speed was limited by the manual code cycle.
decision: Implemented an AI orchestration workflow (plan → review → execute) as a core productivity layer, not a novelty.
result: Consolidated a real, repeatable working method — a recent differentiator few candidates have solidified as an actual practice.

title: Magic Links authentication (JWT)
decision: Designed and implemented passwordless authentication via JWT.

title: New supervisor role tier
problem: The platform had no intermediate validation layer between end users and admins.
decision: Designed and shipped a new 'supervisor' user tier end-to-end.
result: Drove trial adoption across 15 new enterprise accounts and onboarded 2,000+ users to the new role model.

title: Hexagonal architecture migration (Relink v2)
problem: Business domain was tightly coupled to Strapi as infrastructure, making changes hard.
decision: Led the progressive migration to clean/hexagonal architecture to decouple domain from infrastructure, adding Pub/Sub and Cloud Run for scalability.
result: Decoupled domain logic from infrastructure, enabling changes without touching the framework layer.
